reuse.why: Hooks the check into the existing pre-link guard that all six provider link handlers already call, rather than adding it to each handler.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The check sits in the shared link guard in accounts/app.ts, which is the right layer, but inside a function named assertBankAccountNotLinked whose name and purpose (duplicate-link check) no longer describe what it does.

scope.why: Only the guard and one test for the refused link.

maintainability.why: Single enforcement point is good, but a maintainer reading assertBankAccountNotLinked will not expect a closed-account rule there; a separately named guard (or a renamed one) would be clearer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers reach the rule through the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked call.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the rule is added once.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called first by linkGoCardless/SimpleFin/Fintegra/PluggyAi/Akahu/EnableBanking handlers.
